styleIdentity.description: 极简平面矢量像素风：纯色矩形区块拼接、无描边无渐变，靠硬边色块与横向色带切分空间；天空用三段平滑色带做黄昏渐变，山脊与建筑为无细节剪影；角色为粗壮低分辨率的方块人，五官仅由几个深色像素点构成；所有体积感来自有限的明度阶梯而非光影渲染。

camera.perspective: flat side-scroller view, no vanishing point, parallel bands stacked vertically

composition.background: sky bands with dark ridge silhouette and a low sun disc pinned near the top edge
composition.midground: long repeating wall strip with rectangular feature panels, one lamp post
composition.foreground: flat platform floor band, then a rail band, then darker platform base band
composition.characterScale: small, roughly one tenth of frame height, centered on the platform band
composition.objectScale: props are axis-aligned rectangles, sized to character scale
composition.density: sparse; large empty flat color fields, features spaced far apart horizontally

lighting.direction: flat frontal, sun implied at upper right horizon
lighting.contrast: low to medium; only two or three value steps per material
lighting.softness: hard edges with banded sky gradient as the sole soft transition
lighting.mood: quiet dusk, warm horizon against cool dark upper sky

sky.appearance: flat matte color bands, zero texture

wall.appearance: matte mid-brown plaster, unshaded except for band edges

ground.appearance: flat grey slab with a darker base band below

rail.appearance: dark repeating horizontal dashes over a darker strip

wood.appearance: soft tan blocky furniture and luggage

metal.appearance: uniform deep navy garment and equipment surfaces

emissive.appearance: flat glowing disc and framed panels, no blur halo

character.proportions: stubby, wide torso, oversized square head, short legs
character.silhouette: boxy hat brim, tall rectangle body, small rectangular limbs
character.faceAbstraction: two dark square eyes and one mouth pixel, no other features
character.clothing: long dark navy coat with lighter belt band, square hat, small pale hands
character.poseLanguage: upright neutral idle; run and jump read only through leg and body offset

environment.architecture: single long horizontal wall strip with inset rectangular panels; flat roof line silhouette
environment.terrain: perfectly flat platform top, vertical step edges for jumps
environment.props: rectangular picture frame, hanging square panel, three small wall plates, thin lamp post with disc head, bench, luggage stack, railway signal
environment.textureDensity: very low; each prop is one or two flat shapes

shapeLanguage: flat trapezoid and triangle ridge silhouettes
circles only as sun disc, lamp head, signal lamp
constraints: 所有形状必须为轴对齐矩形、三角形或圆形，禁止圆角与自由曲线
禁止描边、渐变、阴影投射与任何体积渲染：面与面之间只用硬边直接相接
天空必须用不超过四段的横向色带表现黄昏，而不是连续渐变
山脊、建筑、角色一律为纯色剪影，禁止内部纹理与细线细节
角色只能用一套粗方块图元，五官仅限眼与嘴的像素点
远景层可平滑卷动，墙面与地面层必须以固定周期重复拼接
发光物（日头、窗、挂画、信号灯、路灯）只允许用高饱和平涂色块表示，不得加光晕或模糊
行李、木箱、长凳等可站立道具必须做成一到两个色块构成的方盒，且顶部为水平面以承载跳跃落点
信号灯必须在红与绿之间整体换色，且颜色需取自强调色组
HUD 面板为墙面同色系的实心矩形，槽位为空/亮两态，不得使用新色

lighting.sun: upper right, implied only by warm horizon color
